title: Yellow Molten Ethiopian Lamb Berbere Stew
description: A salty and molten Ethiopian dish featuring lamb and berbere spices, perfect for a weeknight dinner, wrapped in a shortcrust pastry and served with a side of brine-dried vegetables, making it paleo-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the shortcrust pastry and cut it into 4 equal pieces.
In a large pan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat and cook the lamb until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic to the pan and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the berbere spice, salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth to the pan and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the brine-dried vegetables and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Spoon the lamb and vegetable mixture onto one half of each pastry piece, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Place the pastry pockets on a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
